chapter_title: Concerning the Five Saviours, the Resurrectors of
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶3:**
The second power of spiritual awakening is [GAP-1] — a successive degree by which the mind is raised from the death of falsity into the life of truth.

**¶4:**
And the third power of spiritual awakening is the Divine Love itself, the originating [GAP-2] principle of all that exists, because through Divine Truth proceeding from that Love all affections and perceptions that constitute spiritual life shall [GAP-3] be gathered into unity and return to conjunction with Him, and they receive [GAP-4] the peace of celestial blessedness and enter into eternal rest.

**¶5:**
The fourth power of spiritual awakening is the Divine Wisdom illuminating the understanding, because [GAP-5] it opens the interior rational sight and so lifts the mind into heavenly light.

**¶6:**
The fifth power of spiritual awakening, directed toward those in states of genuine good [GAP-6], is the Divine Love itself, the immutable ground of all spiritual order [GAP-7]. [GAP-8] He encompasses all faculties of will and understanding, and He abides unchangeably in His own Divine order [GAP-9]. He shall remove the obscurities of the natural mind, unveiling the [GAP-10] interior perception that lies hidden over them [GAP-11], and He draws them into conjunction with Himself [GAP-12] through the influx of His Divine purpose [GAP-13], and He [GAP-14] reforms them inwardly, and He raises them into the fullness of spiritual life [GAP-15] in that celestial state, and they abide there in heavenly permanence until [GAP-16] the completion of the entire work of restoration.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The second resurrector is [the Living Spirit].
And the third resurrector is the Father, the First [Man], because by his word shall all lives [and souls] gather in and go to him, and they receive [life] and rest.
The fourth resurrector is the Light Mind, because [he illumines and raises them up].

The fifth resurrector to the good [souls] is the Father, the First established one [over all]. [He encompasses] all the powers, and he stands firm [in his place]. He shall unveil the [light] over them [that was hidden], and he draws them to him [by his call], his will [fills them], and he [renews] them, and he stands them up [in the light] there, and they remain until [the end of all].

fills.explanation: The Living Spirit is the Manichaean figure whose defining role is raising and rescuing — he rescues the First Man from the abyss of darkness, corresponding to the spiritual sense of "raising from the death of falsity into the life of truth," and fits naturally as the second resurrector before the First Man (third) and the Light Mind (fourth).

"The Father, the First Man" is the standard Manichaean title for the primordial divine emanation who enters the cosmic drama; as "originating principle of all that exists" he is the archetypal Man from whom all living elements proceed.

The spiritual reading expands "lives" into "all affections and perceptions that constitute spiritual life," indicating a doublet; "lives and souls" is the natural Manichaean pair where "lives" corresponds to affections (will-elements) and "souls" corresponds to perceptions (cognitive elements).

"Life and rest" is a standard Manichaean eschatological doublet for what the redeemed receive upon returning to the Father; the spiritual reading's "peace of celestial blessedness" corresponds to "life" in the natural register of the Kephalaia.

fills.fill: he illumines and raises them up
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says the Light Mind "opens the interior rational sight and lifts the mind into heavenly light"; in Kephalaia register the Light Nous illumines (opens spiritual sight) and raises up (lifts from darkness), these being his two defining actions as awakener of the soul.

The spiritual reading describes the recipients as "those in states of genuine good," and in Manichaean register "the good souls" is the standard designation for the redeemable light-bearing elements toward whom the fifth resurrector directs his saving action.

The spiritual reading describes "the immutable ground of all spiritual order," and "the First established one over all" is a natural Kephalaia title expressing the Father's supremacy as the unchanging foundation encompassing all things.

The spiritual reading says "He encompasses all faculties of will and understanding," and in the Kephalaia the Father of Greatness contains all the divine powers within himself; "encompasses" captures this containment in the text's expository register.

The spiritual reading says "He abides unchangeably in His own Divine order," and "in his place" is the standard Kephalaia expression for the Father's immutable abiding within his own domain — the Kingdom of Light where he stands firm.

The spiritual reading describes "unveiling the interior perception that lies hidden," and in Manichaean cosmology the "light" trapped within matter is what is hidden and must be unveiled; the Father reveals the light over the souls that was concealed by darkness.

The spiritual reading specifies "interior perception that lies hidden over them," and "that was hidden" in the Kephalaia register describes the concealed light that the Father now unveils — the hiddenness of the divine light in the material mixture.

The spiritual reading says the Father "draws them into conjunction with Himself" through Divine influx; in Manichaean cosmology the divine "call" is the primary mechanism by which the Father attracts scattered light-souls back to himself, and "by his call" is a standard Kephalaia expression.

The spiritual reading describes "the influx of His Divine purpose," and "his will fills them" captures the Swedenborgian concept of influx — the divine will flowing into and filling the receptive souls — translated into the Kephalaia's natural-plane register.

The spiritual reading says "He reforms them inwardly," and "renews" is the Manichaean register equivalent for interior reformation — the Father makes the purified souls new again, restoring them to their original luminous nature.

The spiritual reading says "He raises them into the fullness of spiritual life in that celestial state," and "in the light" is the fundamental Manichaean expression for the state of full restoration — being established in the Kingdom of Light.

The spiritual reading describes "the completion of the entire work of restoration," which in Manichaean cosmology is the final consummation when all light is gathered and the cosmic drama concludes; "the end of all" is a standard Kephalaia eschatological formula.
